baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive plural لمحجوبون is completed by عن ربهم, making the barrier relational and directed away from the one who owns and governs them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship makes the endpoint a sovereign, while access-blocking and chamberlain branches make the veil an administered threshold. The Lord is not generically hidden; this group is placed on the denied side of audience and reception.

activation_trace.role: The lordship, ownership, and authority image supplies the sovereign whose domain and audience are controlled.
The active blocking-of-access image makes the passive condition exclusion rather than mere invisibility.
The chamberlain-office image turns the barrier into regulated admission to a ruler.

changed_reading.after: They are held outside an administered audience with their own sovereign: still under his rule, but denied approach and reception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive in ربهم preserves a relation of care even as عن and لمحجوبون mark interruption between the cared-for group and its source.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant nurture-and-completion branch and the non-dominant growth branch make lordship an ongoing formative process. Access-blocking then reads as a cutoff from what would repair, mature, and complete them.

activation_trace.role: The repair, nurture, and stage-by-stage completion image supplies a formative flow from their Lord.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growing-up image keeps growth live as a second mapped activation rather than collapsing the split root.
The image of preventing access, including light or mercy, functions as interruption of that formative flow.

changed_reading.before: They are spatially separated from their Lord.
changed_reading.after: They are cut off from the sustaining repair and completion implicit in being related to their Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: محجوبون can describe blocked sight, while the same root supplies an inner partition; ربهم remains the object and source they can no longer apprehend.
baseline_models.mechanism: The barrier can be located in the subjects rather than only between two locations. An inward partition blocks the faculty by which lord-formed knowledge would disclose its source, so perceptual incapacity and external exclusion can coexist.

activation_trace.role: The blocked-sight image supplies a failure of perception and makes the barred group unable to apprehend the relational endpoint.
The inner-partition image relocates the screen inside the subject and gives the perceptual failure a bodily-spatial mechanism.
The knowledge-cultivated-by-care image makes recognition of the Lord a formed capacity that the inner partition can obstruct.

changed_reading.before: An external screen stands between two parties.
changed_reading.after: Their own sight and inward receptivity are partitioned from the source that would form recognition, without excluding an external ban as well.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who secure completeness for themselves while producing shortage for others later meet exclusion under the true Owner. The inheritance-exclusion branch of ح ج ب sharpens the veil into a withheld share, so the punishment answers their asymmetrical allocation rather than merely following it.

activation_trace.role: The ownership-and-authority image identifies the final allocator before whom private manipulation of shares is reversed.
The inheritance-exclusion image supplies a concrete legal mechanism of losing or having a due share reduced.
The food-measure image supplies the transactional instrument through which unequal allocation is enacted.
The complete-without-deficiency image supplies what the actors reserve for themselves.
The balance-of-justice image exposes the social transaction as a violation of equitable allocation.
The deficient-measure image supplies the imposed loss that returns structurally as exclusion.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 alternates taking full from people with causing loss to them; the missing-branch root ط ف ف at 83:1 is used only as the opening structural label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-completion, unjust balance, induced deficiency, and focus exclusion; I supply the retributive arrow from shorting another's share to losing access or share under the Owner. A live alternative is simple audience denial with no measure metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The veil is a punishment unrelated in form to the opening transactions.
changed_reading.after: The veil is a counter-measure: agents who engineered another's shortage are themselves excluded from fullness, share, and access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection stirs them from rest and standing places them inside the Lord's jurisdiction, but chamberlain-style blocking distinguishes compulsory appearance from admitted audience. The focus therefore describes presence without reception, not simple absence.

activation_trace.role: The chamberlain image supplies the threshold that can deny audience even to someone already present before the sovereign.
The stirring-of-the-still image supplies compulsory emergence into the scene of judgment.
The day's calamitous-event image makes the temporal marker an event of exposure rather than a neutral date.
The bodily-standing image places humanity upright and present within the sovereign proceeding.
The contextual lordship image expands the sovereign's jurisdiction to all worlds while preparing the focus's personal their-Lord relation.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 first raises humanity and makes it stand for the Lord of the worlds; 83:15 later marks this group as barred from their Lord on that same event-day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, standing, universal jurisdiction, and later barring; I infer a distinction between being compelled into court and being admitted to audience. The live alternative is that standing itself already entails direct audience.

changed_reading.before: Being veiled means being wholly absent from the Lord's presence.
changed_reading.after: They are forcibly present within judgment yet unadmitted to relational audience, a sharper humiliation than mere distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining a name to a register, placing the record within confinement, and marking it legibly form an administrative classification. The later access barrier can then be read as the enacted status of that classification: the record does not merely recount conduct but locates its bearer on one side of the gate.

activation_trace.role: The gatekeeping-office image supplies an institution that can enact a recorded admission status.
The enrolling-a-name-in-a-register image supplies classification into a defined group.
The confinement image supplies the bounded destination assigned by the classification.
The inscribed-register image makes the assigned status fixed and inspectable.

structural_cues: 83:7 locates the wrongdoers' record in confinement, and 83:9 immediately restates it as a marked record before the focus announces exclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enrollment, confinement, marking, and gatekeeping; I infer that classification is operationalized as access status. A live alternative is that the record is evidence only and does not function as a credential.

changed_reading.before: The veil is only an interpersonal refusal at the final encounter.
changed_reading.after: The veil is also an institutional status: a marked registration in the confined class is enacted as denial at the sovereign threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs are recoded as old fictions, while repeated acquisition lays a coating on the heart from which there is no exit. The focus's blocked sight and inner partition become the outward completion of an opacity the subjects have been producing inwardly.

activation_trace.role: The blocked-sight image supplies the perceptual endpoint of repeatedly misreading what is shown.
The inner-partition image gives the heart-coating an internal barrier that can later appear as relational exclusion.
The manifest-sign image supplies something available to recognition before it is dismissed.
The false-tales image supplies the replacement category through which a visible sign is neutralized.
The no-exit coating image supplies accumulated enclosure rather than a momentary error.
The heart image locates the accumulated obstruction in the organ of inward reception.
The acquiring-for-benefit image is reversed into repeated acts that deposit a harmful perceptual layer.

structural_cues: 83:13-14 moves from recited signs to their dismissive relabeling, then بل relocates the problem onto hearts and ما كانوا يكسبون attributes it to repeated acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest signs, their recoding as fictions, heart-coating, repeated acquisition, and focus blindness; I infer that each dismissal deposits opacity until inner habit and external sentence coincide. The live alternative is a wholly imposed final barrier with no continuity of mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A new external veil is imposed only on the final day.
changed_reading.after: The final veil ratifies an acquired way of seeing: self-layered heart opacity becomes complete exclusion from the source it refused to recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate encounter with blazing heat prevents reading the veil as general insulation. Its direction is selective: it blocks approach, light, or mercy from the Lordward side while leaving the subjects exposed to the fireward side.

activation_trace.role: The access-blocking image supplies a directional barrier whose denied endpoint is named by عن ربهم.
The protective-brow image raises a possible shielding function that the next fire-contact scene sharply limits.
The meeting-fire-and-heat image supplies direct exposure immediately after the barrier.
The fiercely blazing-fire image specifies the harmful side to which the barred group remains open.

structural_cues: ثم at 83:16 sequences fire-contact directly after 83:15, while عن ربهم names the side from which the barrier excludes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a directed complement, a possible protective barrier image, and subsequent fire exposure; I infer a one-sided rather than total enclosure. A live alternative is that the two conditions occur in distinct phases with no membrane-like relation.

changed_reading.before: The veil surrounds or shields them from every outside contact.
changed_reading.after: The barrier is selective deprivation: closed toward audience, light, and mercy, yet open toward encounter with the blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elevated register is attended by witnesses described through both nearness and the special favor of royal intimates. Against that admitted circle, the focus's chamberlain barrier becomes a court topology: one group witnesses within, while another remains under the same sovereignty but outside admission.

activation_trace.role: The sovereign-authority image supplies the court around which nearness and exclusion are organized.
The chamberlain image supplies controlled passage between the excluded exterior and the admitted circle.
The elevation-and-honor image gives the admitted register vertical rank as well as location.
The presence-with-witnessing image supplies active attendance inside the privileged scene.
The favored-intimates-of-a-king image turns nearness into admitted status, not merely metric distance.

structural_cues: The lower and higher records use mirrored formulas at 83:7-9 and 83:18-20, but only the higher record is followed by admitted witnesses at 83:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, chamberlain control, elevated rank, witnessing, and royal intimacy; I infer a court-like admission system. A live alternative is that proximity and witnessing describe the record only, without defining the focus barrier.

changed_reading.before: The difference is simply that one group is farther away than another.
changed_reading.after: The difference is admitted status: near witnesses occupy the sovereign interior while the barred remain an excluded constituency at its threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Closure is morally and relationally ambivalent. A secured seal and a containing skin preserve a valuable drink for admitted recipients, whereas the focus screen keeps other recipients outside. The same boundary logic can conserve an interior for the near and exclude those denied entry.

activation_trace.role: The screening-veil image supplies the separating boundary whose value depends on which side receives access.
The nearness image identifies the admitted side of the boundary.
The giving-to-drink image supplies the beneficial content delivered to those inside access.
The secured-preventive-seal image supplies closure that preserves rather than deprives its intended recipient.
The skin-that-holds-its-content image gives the preserving boundary a material container, despite its distance from the immediate fragrance reading.

structural_cues: 83:25-28 moves from a sealed drink to its elevated source and ends with the near ones as recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies screen, seal, container, drink, and nearness; I supply the analogy that one boundary technology can preserve for insiders while excluding outsiders. A live alternative is that مسك contributes fragrance only and no container analogy is active.

changed_reading.before: Any barrier is intrinsically a negative obstruction.
changed_reading.after: A boundary allocates relation: it secures valuable interiority for admitted recipients precisely while exclusion makes the same closure deprivation for the barred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near receive good condition, watering, and an elevated source; the focus's nurture and non-dominant rising branches turn that sequence into a developmental flow. Barring then means being disconnected from the current that nourishes, raises, and completes.

activation_trace.role: The nurture-and-completion image supplies the formative benefit carried by the later material flow.
The non-dominant increase-and-rising image links formation to the later elevated source without erasing the split mapping.
The access-blocking image functions as interruption of the nourishing and elevating current.
The good-condition-and-benefit image supplies the state produced on the receiving side of the flow.
The quenching image materializes reception of sustaining provision.
The height-and-elevation image gives the nourishing source an upward developmental vector.
The nearness image identifies those connected to and drinking from the elevated source.

structural_cues: 83:22-28 progresses from good condition through radiant embodiment and drink to an elevated spring consumed by the near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, rising, blocked access, benefit, watering, elevation, and nearness; I infer that the drink sequence materializes relational care as a flow. The live alternative is that the beverage imagery describes reward without modeling the focus's Lord-relation.

changed_reading.before: The veil removes only a visual privilege.
changed_reading.after: The veil disconnects them from a nurturing current that gives the admitted growth, elevation, and completed good condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offenders visually classify believers and behave as peer monitors, but the text denies them any commission to guard. After reversal, believers occupy the looking and laughing position. Blocked sight and chamberlain control therefore read as revocation of an unauthorized viewpoint and transfer of visual standing.

activation_trace.role: The blocked-sight image supplies loss of the perceptual position from which they had judged others.
The chamberlain image supplies legitimate control of who may occupy an authorized observational position.
The eye-and-insight image supplies the offenders' act of seeing before they classify the believers.
The guarding-and-watching image names the supervisory office that the offenders explicitly did not receive.
The joy-or-wonder manifest in laughter supplies the reversed social response of the believers.
The directed gaze of eye or insight supplies the observational position transferred to the believers.

structural_cues: The missing-branch root غ م ز at 83:30 is used only as a cue for peer signaling; 83:32-33 joins visual classification to denial of any guarding commission, and 83:34-35 reverses who laughs and looks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, an ungranted guarding office, reversed laughter, later looking, and focus blindness; I infer a transfer of authorized visual standing. A live alternative is that the later gaze is reward imagery unrelated to earlier social surveillance.

changed_reading.before: The barred group merely loses private sight of the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Their self-appointed role as watchers and classifiers is revoked: they lose the authorized viewpoint while those they inspected become the admitted observers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those designated through covering the truth become the ones screened away, and the closing return-of-recompense branch sends enacted work back to its agent. The passive focus is thus a material-form reversal: active covering returns as being covered from access.

activation_trace.role: The screening-and-covering image supplies the passive condition that can answer an earlier practice of covering.
The concealing-truth image supplies the active epistemic covering that returns in altered direction.
The recompense-returning-to-its-worker image supplies the causal return arrow from deed to condition.
The producing-an-act image grounds the returned covering in what the agents repeatedly brought about.

structural_cues: The closing question at 83:36 explicitly pairs recompense with what they used to do, while both the focus condition and the final recompense are passively framed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealing truth, a screening veil, work, and recompense returning to the worker; I infer a measure-for-measure reversal between the two covering processes. A live alternative is that كفر functions only as a group label and its covering image does not activate here.

changed_reading.before: The veil is an arbitrary sanction imposed from outside their prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: Their own mode of covering returns upon them: concealment of truth becomes passive concealment from access to their Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines kin-care, covenant, and inheritance branches although the focus names no estate. It remains anchored in ربهم, its possessive relation, and the inheritance-exclusion branch of محجوبون; downstream prose should present it only as a legal-household analogy for forfeited share, never as a literal inheritance claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessive their Lord can sustain a dependent household relation, while the passive barrier has a branch specifically describing exclusion from an allotted inheritance share.

activation_trace.role: The foster-child and caregiver image supplies a dependent relation inside a household of care.
The covenant-and-protection image gives that relation a binding claim rather than mere proximity.
The inheritance-exclusion image supplies the legal mechanism by which a related person loses an allotted share.

changed_reading.before: They are visitors refused entry to a remote presence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble dependents still named by relation yet disinherited from the household's care, protection, and allotted share.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because cloud, lava-tract, rain-cloud, and elevation branches are form-distant from the immediate clause. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by the later drink and elevated-source sequence; downstream prose should call it a material rain-shadow analogy, not a lexical gloss or asserted geography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventories juxtapose a nurturing layered cloud and abundant water with a screen or stony tract, allowing blocked provision to be pictured materially.

activation_trace.role: The low layered cloud image supplies persistent rain that nurtures growth.
The abundant collected-water image supplies the provision whose route can be interrupted.
The stony lava-tract image supplies a terrain-like obstruction that can cast a material shadow across flow.
The great rain-cloud image reactivates hydrological provision inside the later drinking scene.
The elevation image supplies topography and an upstream source for the inferred rain-shadow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The veil is only an abstract visual curtain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it acts like raised barren terrain cutting a population off from the nurturing cloud and collected water available beyond it.

strongest_changes: Compulsory resurrection and standing no longer imply admitted audience: the barred remain present under sovereignty but outside reception.
The opening asymmetry of full measure versus imposed shortage turns exclusion into a reciprocal counter-measure and withheld share.
Heart-coating and repeated acquisition make the final external barrier continuous with an inward opacity the subjects accumulated.
The fire sequence makes the barrier selective rather than protective, while the near witnesses define the admitted side of the court.
The closing return of recompense lets active covering of truth return as passive covering from access.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus clause sustained sovereign, developmental, perceptual, transactional, legal, material, and social-role mechanisms without forcing a single winner. Especially productive were the split رب mapping, the chamberlain and inheritance branches of حجب, the contrast between excluding veil and preserving seal, and the reversal from self-appointed watchers to barred objects of view.
remaining_uncertainties: The text does not specify whether denied audience centrally entails denied sight, denied speech, denied mercy, or all of them.
The record-as-access-status model depends on an administrative arrow not stated directly in the packet.
The nurture-flow, container, household, and rain-shadow models are branch-driven analogies and should remain visibly exploratory.
The later looking scenes do not name their object, so visual-role transfer remains plausible rather than exclusive.
